edges.label: Briefed SASC staff on 21 Oct 2019 and SSCI members on 23 Oct 2019
edges.note: Davis told The New York Times on the record that he had given classified briefings on retrievals of unexplained objects to both committees within 48 hours.

edges.label: Same report carried Reid's statement on retrieved materials
edges.note: In the 23 July 2020 article Reid said it was 'extremely important that information about the discovery of physical materials or retrieved craft come out', published alongside Davis's account of his briefings.

edges.label: Employed by the FFRDC operator at the time of the 2019-2020 briefings
edges.note: The New York Times identified Davis as working for Aerospace Corp. when reporting his classified briefings on retrievals. The corporation has never publicly addressed whether it had any institutional role.

edges.label: Author of record of the notes of the alleged 16 October 2002 Wilson meeting
edges.note: Notes attributed to Davis describing a meeting with former DIA director Vice Adm. Thomas R. Wilson surfaced in 2019 among the estate papers of Edgar Mitchell. Provenance is a private estate, not a government release; Davis has not publicly repudiated authorship.
